criteria.notes: Forum agenda: venue identity, running clock, current session with time range, room and progress, plus a three-item upcoming list with times and rooms.
Conference-agenda concept retained: one dominant now-card beside a timeline-marked upcoming column.
Reads as a hall agenda board rather than a calendar widget; the progress rail and now-marker are session-specific.
Session title dominates the card and reaches its intended size now that auto-fit resolves; upcoming titles and times stay above their floors.
Light-theme scenario preserves accent, now-marker and divider contrast; the default holds mint and coral against near-black.
Long-label and iCalendar scenarios wrap session titles completely; upcoming rows clamp the room line without losing the title.

The now-card uses a deliberate three-zone rhythm: marker pinned top, content centred, meta pinned bottom above the progress rail. The upcoming column repeats that rhythm, and the empty state substitutes a centred message.
Timeline markers, dividers and progress rail render crisply from 600x600 through 1920x1080; no raster media involved.
Shares a dark palette with other operational examples, but the now-card plus timeline structure is not duplicated elsewhere.
